name: Z-function prefix match length scan
definition: Z_0=0; maintain [l,r) initially [0,0); for i=1,…,n−1 set z_i=min(r−i,z_{i−l}) if i<r else 0; while i+z_i<n and x_{z_i}=x_{i+z_i}, increment z_i; if i+z_i>r set l=i,r=i+z_i.
variables: x sequence, z_i matched prefix length, [l,r) rightmost matching interval

name: Aho–Corasick multi-pattern failure automaton
definition: Build a trie of patterns; f(root)=root, f(v)=root for root children; for edge u→v labeled a with u≠root set f(v)=δ(f(u),a), where δ follows trie edges or failure links, returning root if none. Scan q←δ(q,x_i); report terminal patterns at q and its failure ancestors.
variables: Trie states, f failure link, δ transition, q current state; finite nonempty patterns
